fields.execution: Three runs sequentially, exactly once each, in suggested order. Stop on any fault. Audit and release exact lease between runs.

d4: Root creates a reviewed evaluator successor or registration-binding adaptation from producer-home-remap.json after all six endpoints are terminal; D4 r2 plan is not modified.

notes: Run from a ROOT native exec_command session, not a Claude Bash background wrapper (30 min default kill).
caffeinate -ims is scoped to this command: it holds assertions through dispatcher start, observer wait and exit receipt; no -u, no display wake, no pmset changes.
If any tool timeout exists it must exceed work 3780 + cleanup 10 + postflight; use an explicit bound such as 4500 seconds only if the tool supports it; otherwise omit the parameter.
Dispatcher refuses unless on AC and its parent is exactly `/usr/bin/caffeinate -ims` holding PreventUserIdleSystemSleep and PreventSystemSleep (power_guard.py).
Cheap read-only monitor: python -B watch_progress.py --run-id <id> (no new loop code, no signalling).

preflight_before_each_dispatch: all candidate hashes and gate pins (incl. checkpoint c10d90ec..., failure audit 032e681c..., lease release 14982746...)

spent paths absent: output, attempt.claimed, launch.claimed, dispatch, launch-envelope, launch-approval, parent-preflight, parent-execution, execution-exit, observer.log, progress-reports.jsonl, progress-alert.json, cancel
shared state.seed-priority-remaining.pending.json absent; serial single writer (no active_long_campaign / diagnostic, no training hold)
empty registered pycache; dependency inventory pins; source and runtime manifests unchanged
AC power and scoped caffeinate assertion (power_guard)
rule: This file is a template. It records no approval. Only a user message received after packet_built_at_utc that approves this concrete three-run plan may be copied verbatim into the authorization; a plain 'Go' naming the plan is enough, no typed hashes. Earlier Go messages are consumed.
steps: 1. Independent review of this package; write review file {path,sha256,package_manifest_sha256}.
2. After fresh user approval: write authorization document exclusively (verbatim message, at_utc).

3. parent-gates.json = parent-gates-proposal.json fields + status approved_exactly_once_per_registered_run, proposal_sha256, authorization_path/sha256, registration_index_sha256, independent_review, and pins += authorization, review, package-manifest.json. Written exclusively.
4. registration-index.json = registration-index-proposal.json rows with status reviewed_exact_registrations_parent_promoted. Written exclusively.

5. For each run in order: root native exec_command session runs the command below; then r3 audit.py with the launcher's envelope/parent-execution/execution-exit; then exact lease release; then next run.
6. Stop on any fault; no retry, seed replacement, selection or promotion.
